free_text: The patient is a 67-year-old male with a PSA of 4.7 and a prior biopsy showing Gleason 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1). The mpMRI prostate showed PI-RADS 2 with no focal lesions, and the pathology AI predicted grade group 2. Given the low-grade disease and PI-RADS 2, active surveillance is recommended to weigh treatment benefit against patient preferences.
